definitions.explanation: A product made in limited quantities or available only for a limited time or at a specific location. Common in Japanese retail culture, where seasonal and regional limited editions are extremely popular.

examples.japanese: この{限定品|げんていひん}はすぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: This limited edition item sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}{限定|げんてい}の{限定品|げんていひん}をお{土産|みやげ}に{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a Kyoto-exclusive product as a souvenir.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{限定品|げんていひん}の{桜|さくら}{味|あじ}のチョコレートが{毎年|まいとし}{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: The seasonal limited edition cherry blossom flavored chocolate is popular every year.

notes:
USAGE:
{限定品|げんていひん} is extremely common in Japanese consumer culture. Products are frequently marketed with modifiers like {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい} (limited time), {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい} (seasonal), {地域|ちいき}{限定|げんてい} (regional), or {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい} (limited quantity). These limited editions drive consumer interest and urgency.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期間|きかん}{限定品|げんていひん} (limited-time product)
- {季節|きせつ}{限定品|げんていひん} (seasonal limited edition)
- {地域|ちいき}{限定品|げんていひん} (regional exclusive)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定品|げんていひん} (limited quantity product)
